screening_decisions.reason: Not a randomized or cross-over trial comparing glucocorticoids; appears to be modeling/review of radiographic change without a comparative glucocorticoid arm or trial-level radiograph evaluation per criteria.
Randomized, double-blind trial in adults with RA comparing prednisolone (7.5 mg/day) vs placebo with radiographic hand assessments (Larsen index); steroid vs non-steroid arms present.
Systematic review; not itself a randomized or cross-over comparative trial with radiographic outcomes as required.
Multicentre randomized trial comparing combination including prednisolone vs SSZ monotherapy; radiographic damage scored in hands/feet (Sharp/van der Heijde); includes steroid vs non-steroid arms.
Two-year randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of prednisone 10 mg/day vs placebo in adults with early RA; serial radiologic hand/foot studies performed.
Two-year randomized controlled trial of intramuscular depomedrone (glucocorticoid) vs placebo in established RA; radiographs of hands/feet assessed by Larsen; steroid vs non-steroid arms present.
Narrative/review of efficacy and safety; not a randomized or cross-over comparative trial with radiographic outcomes as per criteria.
Feasibility/commentary piece; no randomized comparative trial of glucocorticoids with standardized radiograph evaluation described.

Long-term follow-up of patients originally randomized in the COBRA trial (prednisolone-containing regimen vs SSZ monotherapy) with radiographs scored (Sharp/van der Heijde); preserves randomized comparison of steroid vs non-steroid arms with radiographic evaluation.
Systematic review/meta-analysis; not a primary randomized or cross-over comparative trial of glucocorticoids with radiograph assessment.
Randomized trial in early active RA assigning 7.5 mg/day prednisolone vs no prednisolone; radiographs of hands and feet scored by modified Sharp; steroid vs non-steroid arms.
Narrative report advocating for corticosteroids; no randomized comparative trial or standardized radiographic evaluation per criteria.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial of low-dose prednisolone vs placebo in early RA; primary outcome radiologic damage via modified Sharp; satisfies all criteria.
Observational drug continuation analysis in private practices; not a randomized comparative glucocorticoid trial and no standardized hand/foot radiographic outcomes.

Adults with early RA received MTX with randomized addition of prednisolone vs MTX alone; hand/foot radiographs assessed by Larsen; comparative steroid vs non-steroid arms with standardized radiograph evaluation.
Survey/observational prescribing patterns; not a randomized or cross-over trial with glucocorticoid comparison and radiographic assessment.
Review of safety; not a randomized comparative trial with hand/foot radiographic outcomes.
Double-blind randomized study adding prednisone 5 mg vs placebo in RA; progression of hand erosions reported; meets criteria (adult RA, steroid vs non-steroid arms, radiographs of hands).
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of IV methylprednisolone pulses vs saline in RA; radiography used to assess erosions at baseline and 12 months; steroid vs non-steroid arms.
Prospective multicentre randomized placebo-controlled trial of prednisolone 7.5 mg/day over 2 years with standardized hand radiographic scoring (Larsen, joint space narrowing); satisfies criteria.

Randomized controlled trial including an arm with initial combination therapy with tapered high-dose prednisone compared to strategies without glucocorticoids; radiographic damage scored (Sharp/van der Heijde).

Multicenter randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of 5 mg/day prednisolone vs placebo in early RA; hand/foot radiographs at 6, 12, and 24 months scored by standardized methods; steroid vs non-steroid arms.
Meta-analysis across second-line drugs; not a primary randomized glucocorticoid trial with standardized hand/foot radiographic outcomes.

Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of prednisolone 7.5 mg/day in early RA with radiologic outcomes (Larsen); this report covers the year after discontinuation but retains randomized steroid vs non-steroid comparison with radiographs.
Randomized comparison of DMARD alone vs DMARD + prednisolone for one year in RA; hand radiographs (Larsen) evaluated; steroid vs non-steroid arms present.
Review of joint damage and disability; not a randomized or cross-over glucocorticoid trial and no trial-level standardized radiograph evaluation.
